description: Drought Response and Recovery: A Basic Guide for Water Utilities is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA, U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. Water utility personnel can work through this straightforward guide to help them be better prepared and more resilient to drought. The guide presents real-world examples, best practices, and lessons learned in drought response and recovery. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought. Assets: Energy and Utilities, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
